attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Nursing (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.alternatives: The continuing education required for ARNP national certification meets the CE requirement for both ARNP and RN license renewal; documentation of current ARNP certification verifies compliance.

topics.who: ARNPs who prescribe opioids during the three-year renewal cycle (course must address current CDC prescribing guidelines)
Nurses who care for children and/or dependent adults (each course 2 contact hours)

rules.notes: Opioid CE documentation is sent with the renewal application. Mandatory reporter courses: child and/or dependent adult; current HHS course certificates last 3 years (pre-July 2019 IDPH course: 5 years).
